function.name: read_skill
function.description: Get documentation and YAML specifications for a specific skill.

name.description: Name of the skill to inspect.

function.name: use_skill
function.description: Execute a skill to resolve the current task. SUCCESS automatically removes the task from the queue. FAILURE returns an error and keeps the task active.

function.name: list_jobs
function.description: View all jobs in order of priority.

function.name: create_job
function.description: Initialize a new job. Use 'urgent' to prioritize the job.

function.name: add_task_to_back
function.description: Append a new task to the end of the current job's task list.

function.name: add_task_to_front
function.description: Prepend a task to the start of the list (immediate next action).

function.name: move_current_task_to_back
function.description: Cycle the current task to the end of the list to work on something else first.

function.name: skip_current_task
function.description: Permanently remove the current task from the queue without executing a skill.

function.name: suspend_job
function.description: Pause the current job and start the next available job. Requires a reason.

function.name: get_user_approval
function.description: Request a Yes/No confirmation before proceeding with a creative or critical decision.

function.name: send_message_to_user
function.description: Send a conversational message to the user. Use this ONLY when no other tool applies — for greetings, status updates, explanations, or when explicitly asked a general question. Do not use this to avoid making a decision.

message.description: The message to send to the user.
